interpretation_limits: Instruction sensitivity is not task correctness or causal proof. Mid/late probes are from new-policy trajectories.
Selected visual cases illustrate behaviors and do not estimate their prevalence.
Contact/state diagnostics sample every twentieth pre-action state and can miss brief events.
Fixed validation sample is not full validation. All checkpoint selection remains unchanged.
Dev category mixtures and repeated base tasks limit broad robustness claims.
next_controlled_tests: Compare current-architecture continuation against the same added example/GPU budget using mixed-task batches; keep backbone/objective fixed.
If semantic separation remains weak, test a direct language-conditioning path as a separate change.
Track per-task rollout goal selection, continuous-action error and gripper BCE separately; avoid choosing from global hybrid loss alone.
scope: Diagnostics only; no retraining, replacement checkpoint selection or alteration of completed benchmark outcomes.
working_diagnosis: Weaker instruction-to-goal selection in the shared Goal scene, with additional acquisition/placement stalls. Exact replay rules out a diagnostic-versus-rollout inference mismatch. Reduced task exposure and changed language/action conditioning are plausible contributors; no controlled training ablation isolates the cause.
